title: Mary's Thank-You Song
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Mary stayed with Elisabeth. Her heart was so happy that her words came out like a song.
Mary said, “My heart tells how great the Lord is! I am so glad in Him who saves me. He looked kindly on plain, humble me.”
She said that He is strong and holy. He fills hungry people with good things. He lifts up the small and humble.
p2: He keeps the promises He made long ago to Abraham. Now He was keeping them through Mary’s baby, Jesus. After three months, Mary went home.
You can sing a thank-you too. Tonight, name three gifts from Heavenly Father, like your bed and your family. Then hum, “Thank You!”
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
